_readme: One entry per photograph actually present in public/photos/. The site shows a photo ONLY when its key exists here, so a picture can never appear without its attribution. Keys: 'areas/<country>/<area-slug>' and 'countries/<country>'. Delete an entry and the generated terrain art comes back automatically. 'licence' must be the exact licence short name from the source page (e.g. 'CC BY-SA 4.0', 'CC0', 'Public domain'). 'ext' defaults to jpg.

areas/malaysia/mount-kinabalu.title: Mount Kinabalu seen from Kundasang
